## Frequently Asked Questions
What is the Aged Care Award pay rate for 2026-27?

Under the Aged Care Award (MA000018), the Level 1 base rate is $27.77/hr from 1 July 2026. The casual rate (including 25% loading) is $34.71/hr. Higher classification levels receive progressively higher rates.

Permanent employees under the Aged Care Award receive 1.75x their base rate for Sunday work. For a Level 1 employee, that's $48.60/hr on Sundays.

Public holiday work under the Aged Care Award is paid at 2.5x the base rate. For Level 1, that's $69.43/hr.
